meta.title: Lab tests: VO₂max, lactate profile, training zones
meta.description: VO₂max, lactate profile, fat and carbohydrate use, running economy and anthropometry. What each test measures, how to prepare and what it costs.

hero.title: Lab tests: know your numbers
hero.subtitle: Training zones from your own body, not from formulas.
hero.secondaryCta: Which test is right for me?

what.title: What happens in a test
what.s1: You run or ride, a little harder every step.
what.s2: Heart rate, oxygen use and, from a drop of blood, lactate are measured.
what.s3: You get your thresholds, VO₂max and training zones.

zones.title: Train at the right intensity
zones.text: Zones from your own thresholds, not age formulas.

progress.title: See real progress
progress.text: A retest shows exactly what changed.

race.title: Race smarter
race.text: Know the pace or power you can hold.

prep.title: How to prepare
prep.fastedNote: Fat and carbohydrate test and Performance: come fasted, nothing to eat for 8 hours before, water only.

prepare.title: How to prepare
prepare.text: Come rested, with no hard training in the 24 hours before. Fasted for the fat and carbohydrate test and the Performance package. Full instructions come with your booking.

location.title: Where
location.text: You get the address of the test in your booking confirmation.

after.title: After the test
after.text: You get your results explained and, from the lactate and VO₂max tests, your personal training zones.
after.offer: Every test ends with an offer: {days} days of Plan for free, or your first month of Coaching at −{percent} %.

prepare.question: How do I prepare?
prepare.answer: Come rested, with no hard training in the 24 hours before. Eat lightly 2–3 hours before, or come fasted for the fat and carbohydrate test and Performance. Full instructions come with your booking.

fit.question: Am I fit enough for a test?
fit.answer: Yes. Every test starts easy and gets harder step by step, and you stop when you can't go on. Your results are yours, at any level. If you're ill or injured, move the test.

duration.question: How long does it take?
duration.answer: From {min} to {max} minutes, depending on the test. Each test above shows its time.

results.question: What do I get?
results.answer: Your results explained at the end of the test and, from the lactate and VO₂max tests, your personal training zones.

cancel.question: Can I cancel or move it?
cancel.answer: Yes, free of charge until 24 hours before the start. After that, call or email.
